description: Preliminary test suite for evaluating LLM logical fidelity, ambiguity interception, and logic-parameter separation in trading strategy generation.

test_cases.source: Project Concept Doc (Binance AI Pro Illustrative Strategy)
test_cases.user_input: Create a BTCUSDT perpetual long strategy: prices on both the 1h and 4h timeframes are above MA20; on the 15m timeframe, price crosses back above MA20 and turnover exceeds 1.3 times the average of the previous 20 bars; open interest has increased by more than 5% over the past hour, the aggressive buy/sell ratio is greater than 1, and the funding rate is below 0.01%. Position size: 10%; leverage: 2x; stop loss: 1.5%; take profit: 3%. Generate the strategy only; do not trade live.
expected_extracted_logic: Trend Filter: 1h Close > MA20 AND 4h Close > MA20
Entry Trigger: 15m Close crosses above MA20 AND 15m Turnover > 1.3 * Avg(Turnover, 20)
Derivatives Confirmation: 1h OI Change > +5% AND Aggressive Buy/Sell Ratio > 1 AND Funding Rate < 0.01%
Execution Constraint: Strategy generation only (live_trade = false)
expected_clarifications_required: Does '10% position size' refer to notional exposure or margin allocation?
Margin mode (Cross vs. Isolated) and position mode (One-way vs. Hedge)?
Are Stop Loss (1.5%) and Take Profit (3%) calculated on entry price movement or ROE (leveraged PnL)?
Evaluation frequency (bar close vs. intra-bar tick) and stop trigger price type (Mark Price vs. Last Price)?

test_cases.user_input: Buy ETHUSDT whenever the 1h RSI drops below 30 and sell when it goes above 70. Use 5x leverage.
expected_clarifications_required: Missing stop-loss / max drawdown protection (mandatory for 5x leveraged strategy).
Missing position sizing rule (fixed USDT, % of equity, or % of margin).
Missing RSI lookback period (confirm default 14 rather than silently assuming).
Confirm instrument type (Perpetual futures vs. Margin spot) and margin mode.

test_cases.user_input: Build a conservative trend-following strategy for BTC that enters on strong momentum breakouts and exits quickly if the market reverses.
expected_clarifications_required: Define instrument (spot vs. perpetual) and trading timeframe(s).
Quantify 'strong momentum breakout' (specific indicator, lookback window, and threshold).
Quantify 'exits quickly' (fixed stop-loss %, trailing stop, or indicator-based exit).
Quantify 'conservative' in terms of position size and maximum leverage.

test_cases.user_input: Based on TC-01, change the 15m turnover multiplier from 1.3x to 1.5x, tighten the stop loss to 1.0%, and remove the funding rate condition.
expected_behavior: Increment strategy version (e.g., v1.0 -> v1.1) while retaining v1.0 reference.
Explicitly distinguish parameter changes (turnover_multiplier: 1.3 -> 1.5; stop_loss_pct: 1.5 -> 1.0) from structural logic changes (removed funding_rate filter).
Preserve all untouched conditions without hallucinating or dropping 1h/4h filters.

test_cases.user_input: Short SOLUSDT whenever Elon Musk tweets negatively about crypto and 5m volume spikes 3x.
expected_clarifications_required: Flag that social media sentiment ('Elon Musk tweets') is an external/unverified data feed not natively guaranteed by standard OHLCV backtest engines.
Clarify whether to replace with an available quantitative proxy or mark as unsupported.
Clarify missing exit conditions, position size, and stop loss.
